Procedure/assertion status: PROPOSED; source curation is not approved policy.

A latest addressed SUPPORTED or VERIFIED B09 assessment with reviewed physical supporting observations on each target may justify a qualified proposal.

tasks.expected_outcome: Recover the reviewed missed collection at this synthetic collection point; this does not resolve any unproven capacity issue
tasks.verification_criteria: Independent reviewed completion followed by scheduled/actual pickups and at least24hours after pickup with a dated reaccumulation observation
risks: Synthetic proposed guidance, not approved municipal policy
A missed-pickup recovery does not prove that capacity is adequate

expected_outcomes: Recover the missed collection, then independently observe whether waste reaccumulates under scheduled service
risks: Simulated work and field observations only; no actual municipal dispatch
uncertainties: The original genuine AI run reached its token budget before reassessment; this reassessment and draft are operator-assisted
Both capacity and missed-service explanations retain their recorded assessment and missing evidence
No post-work24hour observation window has occurred; completion must not be presented as resolution

monitoring.verification_criteria: All required scheduled pickups completed and no reaccumulation over at least24hours after the actual pickup; absent opportunity remains unresolved

limitations: Immutable draft receipt is not current execution authority
